summary_1line: Krishna and Arjuna slaughter forest creatures as Khandava burns; Indra tries to quench the fire, but Arjuna counters the rains and continues the devastation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna and Arjuna stand in their chariots on opposite sides of the blazing Khandava forest while terrified animals flee and arrows rain down upon them.
A serpent mother rises from the burning earth while swallowing her son to save him, only for Arjuna to sever her head with a sharp arrow.
Indra fills the sky with storm clouds and lightning over the burning forest while Arjuna releases a divine weapon that scatters the clouds and dries the rain.
